title: The carriage horses walk out properly
items: Hans's pair walk with a real stride, one foot after another, picking up and folding each leg, with a nod of the head at every step.
The brougham now goes at a slow carriage walk, about 3 mph, instead of a crawl; a lap of the block takes about ten minutes.
Otis Bardwell's 1835 wagon team walks the same way.
